# Cross-sectional study

::: {.callout-warning title="Missing patients"}
There are 53 missing patients in the cross-sectional study currently.
:::


Using a Mann-Whitney U test, Holm-corrected, we found out the only significant different between the groups was between the Normal and GPAO groups for $\Delta$CT. The other comparisons were not significant (p>0.05). The results are summarized in @fig-cross-sectional-study.

{{< embed ../../notebooks/cross_sectional_study.ipynb#fig-cross-sectional-study >}}

This contredicts previous results from @Sayah2020-ym, which found a significant difference in ocular rigidity between the normal and glaucoma groups (glaucoma having less rigid eyes).
